Markets.title: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
Markets.summary: Tata Motors' commercial vehicle division reported a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing a loss from the previous year. Revenue from operations rose 42% to ₹23,930 crore, driven by improved demand from higher fleet utilization and industrial activity.

Markets.title: US data centre spending seen more than doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028, estimates BoFA
Markets.summary: Global data centre spending is projected to reach $1 trillion in 2026 and surge to $2.1 trillion by 2028. This rapid infrastructure expansion to $2.93 trillion by 2030 is driven by increasing demand for artificial intelligence services.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields rise but 10-year stays below 5% as AI jitters persist
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields rose following a previous drop, though the benchmark 10-year yield remained below 5% amid lingering AI market concerns. Strong economic activity and sticky inflation continued to influence bond markets while expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike next week weakened further.

Markets.title: EAAA India Alternatives mops up Rs 360 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on Oct 26
Markets.summary: EAAA India Alternatives raised about Rs 360 crore from anchor investors ahead of its initial public offering. The IPO, which consists entirely of an offer for sale, opens for public subscription on October 26.

Markets.title: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on  strong interest income, lower funding costs
Markets.summary: Shriram Finance reported a 59.4% year-on-year rise in standalone profit to Rs 3,677 crore for the second quarter of FY27. The profit growth was driven by higher net interest income, lower funding costs, and a 17% increase in assets under management.

Markets.title: Shree Cement profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 263 crore on higher fuel costs
Markets.summary: Shree Cement reported a 15% year-on-year drop in September-quarter net profit to Rs 263 crore due to soaring fuel costs. Despite a 24% increase in revenue and 14% growth in sales volumes, this marks the company's third consecutive quarterly profit decline.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
Geo-Political.summary: Following the fatal shooting of two Israeli soldiers by Palestinian gunmen at a West Bank checkpoint on Friday, Israeli forces began demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron. The attack took place outside the city in the morning.
